property_summary: For any token id that is unminted (querying c.ownerOf(id) reverts) and any caller, calling c.transferFrom must revert because no caller is authorized to move a token owned by nobody; the mutant lacks the authorization check and lets any caller succeed, changing the token's ownership.
change_summary: Remove the NOT_AUTHORIZED check so any caller can transfer any token, changing `_ownerOf[id]` where the original would revert.
